decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records that primary mints and secondary sales fund the prize pools forever.
The candidate already records that primary mints fund the prize pools, while secondary-sale funding belongs to the separate prize-pool funding Requirement.
Clarifying which sales fund prize pools does not change the requirement to enforce a flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
Prize-pool funding sources do not change the asset delivered by a primary mint.
The funding clarification does not change the Chainlink VRF selection method, eligible ticket holders, or verification method.
The source change concerns prize-pool funding and does not alter the existing Winners-page announcement or one-click claim workflow.
The clarification of prize-pool funding sources does not change the Transak provider or supported fiat payment methods.
Prize-pool funding does not affect the optional confirmation email or its referral-code content.
The funding clarification does not change the NFT mint number's role as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
Prize-pool funding sources do not change referral badge thresholds or award conditions.
The deferred Discord server is unrelated to the clarification that primary and secondary sales fund prize pools.
The Big Block winner count, award amount, sales-count trigger, and eligible population remain unchanged; the modified funding detail belongs to the prize-pool funding Requirement.
